requirements.interaction: One compressed container, double-click to mount, expose normal DNG sequence and audio
requirements.decompression: On-demand reads; no full-size extraction before mounting
requirements.cache: Bounded memory cache; optional bounded disk cache, no full-clip materialization by default
requirements.compression_presets: Multiple lossless effort presets; near-lossless/lossy are explicitly separate quality modes
requirements.priority: Temporal RAW compression, efficient decoding and bounded random-access work

jxl_status.fp_lj92_comparison: Not measured. No claimed percentage improvement over fp hardware LJ92.

external_comparison.limitation: JPEG-LS is not LJ92; static RAW datasets are not SIGMA fp video.

temporal_studies.title: Real-time lossless compression of mosaic video sequences
temporal_studies.limitation: 8-bit clips; first Bayer sequence is simulated from full-colour footage; not evidence of 12-bit fp performance.

temporal_studies.title: Lossless Video Coding Using Multi-Frame Motion Compensation
temporal_studies.metric: Zero-order entropy of residuals relative to single-reference motion compensation
temporal_studies.limitation: Not final compressed file size, and tested on green bands of conventional colour video.

temporal_studies.title: NeuralLVC: Neural Lossless Video Compression via Masked Diffusion with Temporal Conditioning
temporal_studies.limitation: Native YUV420 Xiph CIF, not Bayer RAW. Encoding and decoding are both expensive; not a ready-to-use mounted editing solution.

candidate_research_directions: Multiple motion-compensated reference frames with deterministic integer prediction
Temporal conditional entropy model, not just subtract-and-Zstd
Noise-aware predictor that still codes every original residual sample in lossless mode
Optimize actual bit cost including vectors, reference IDs, weights, modes and restart overhead
Spend effort at encode time; keep decode transforms simple and reference dependencies bounded
previous_probe_limit: Three low-signal frames plus generic Zstd are a control experiment, not a bound on temporal RAW codec efficiency.

hybrid_candidate.status: Design candidate only; no trained model benchmarked on this Mac or Windows.
hybrid_candidate.encoder: Traditional global/block motion search and optional neural optical-flow proposals on low-resolution encoder-only proxies; refine and score on original CFA samples.
hybrid_candidate.selection: Compare actual total coded bytes: residual + motion + reference IDs + weights + modes + restart overhead. Retain intra and non-neural candidates.
hybrid_candidate.bitstream: Store explicit fixed-point motion/prediction parameters and complete lossless residuals.
hybrid_candidate.decoder: Deterministic integer reconstruction and traditional entropy decoding; neural runtime is not required for this candidate.
acceptance_metrics: Size relative to LJ92 on representative native RAW clips
Peak RAM and bounded cache usage
Identical decoded samples across macOS and Windows
limitations: Optical-flow accuracy alone does not establish a coding benefit.
Low-resolution proxies are for encoder search only; all residuals use original samples.
An encoder-only model does not capture every potential benefit of a learned decoder entropy model.
